# CANDIDATE: CLOSING_VWAP_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Near the close, extreme deviation from VWAP with rejection candles often reverts intraday. This edge exists because institutional algos often unwind VWAP-deviation positions into the close, creating mean-reversion opportunities when price shows rejection (long wick) at extreme deviations.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: In the last 30 minutes (15:00‑15:30 ET), if price deviates >0.6% from the session VWAP and the bar shows a wick‑to‑body ratio >2 (long wick opposite the deviation), then enter opposite direction at the close of that bar.  
Exit: Chart‑stop placed beyond the wick extreme (opposite side of entry). Primary target at VWAP (mean reversion) or 1R, whichever hits first. Optional runner trail using premium‑stop 0.5% if price reaches VWAP early.  
Regime filters: VIX < 25 (avoid high‑vol chaos), no major news after 14:30 (to avoid post‑news drift), and ADX < 20 (to avoid trending days where deviation persists).
